Space Marine 2 should be easy to recommend. The combat feels brutal, weapons hit hard, and the presentation nails the Space Marine power fantasy. Unfortunately, terrible faction balance ruins half the game’s content.

Compared to Tyranids, Chaos missions are a full difficulty tier higher, not because of smart design, but due to visual clutter, misleading cues, constant flinching, and stun-lock loops that strip player control. Chaos Spawn variants are hard to distinguish, flood encounters in large groups, and turn combat into frustration instead of skill-based challenge.

Many players actively avoid Chaos missions, effectively halving the playable map pool to 6. This is not minor. It is a fundamental design failure.

To head off the inevitable “skill issue” or “git gud” hot takes from the internet trolls, here are the Devs' own stats (for anyone capable of reading):

35 billion Tyranid Warriors killed, well over triple the Chaos Spawn count.

The top three missions played are all Tyranid.

Third-place map has half the play count of the top two. Chaos missions are not ranked at all because they simply didn't get played enough to meet the threshold.

Source (forgive the link to reddit, but the original Dev post has disappeared): 
https://www.reddit.com/r/Spacemarine/comments/1qk0yze/no_yeah_sure_chaos_is_fine/

This is not a few loud complaints. Players are actively avoiding Chaos missions, and with six difficulty modes available, this proves it is not a skill issue. It is about fun.

Saber have stayed silent despite overwhelming feedback. Their lack of response shows they see no problem, consider the state of the game to be fine, and are unlikely to fix it. With great heaviness in my heart, I have no choice but to say: not recommended.

Besides some minor preformance issues and the fact that the game loop and map choice for pve gets rather repetative I think its definetly worth picking up if its on sale which happens alot so you shouldnt have to wait that long.
